nodes.label: Author a new planar hook-transfer room (profile planar-hook-depth-v2, complex mode) whose objective is to reach the north boundary doorway at (4,0,0) from the player start at (3,13,0). A wall band on
nodes.summary: First layout: M1 is a two-cell gate occupying the doorway (9,6) and the north cell (9,5). Every direct face is unusable: the north push from the reachable stance (9,7) is stopped by the wall (9,4); the south, east and west stances are the wall (9,4), the void (8,6) and the sealed north-side pocket. M0 is a three-cell vertical bar starting at (6,9)..(6,11); the row-6 band stops any naive northward transport at x=6, so it must first be driven east into column 8 and then north until its top member stands in the void socket (8,6). From (7,7) an eastward push makes I=(8,7), C=(8,6), T=(9,6), d=R a lateral contact that drives the whole gate into the siding {(10,5),(10,6)} and opens the doorway. The tool's own arm then occupies (9,6), so the player must walk around through the open south area to (10,8) and drive the tool west back out of the doorway before the passage to (4,0) is walkable.

notes.change: First layout: M1 is a two-cell gate occupying the doorway (9,6) and the north cell (9,5). explanations.headline: Replace the first invalid candidate with a verified planar hook-transfer room: reach (3,3,0) in the sealed north gallery from the player start (12,13,0). The wall band on row 7 has a single doorway at (8,7) plugged by the two-cell gate M1, flanked by void cells (6,7),(7,7),(9,7); the three-cell bar M0 starts at (5,10)..(5,12) in the south hall.
explanations.action: Final layout: M0 is transported independently (four east pushes on rows 10-12, three north pushes up column 9) to the overhang dock (9,7),(9,8),(9,9); a west push from stance (10,8) inputs member (9,8) while the overhanging member (9,7) makes lateral contact with the gate foot (8,7), translating M0 into the doorway and M1 west to (7,6),(7,7); an opposite-direction east withdrawal from (7,8) returns M0 to the dock and reopens (8,7)/(8,6); a second west push from (8,6) parks M1 on the void-backed socket (6,6),(6,7), freeing the stair (7,6),(7,5),(7,4) so the player can walk into the gallery and stand on (3,3). verify-complex passed on the first run: 35/35 checks, overall passed, classification complex-structurally-verified, replayPassed true.
explanations.result: The first candidate's doorway and siding geometry left a reachable direct push face on the gate, so the contact necessity checks failed. The final room removes every direct gate face (wall, fatal void or sealed pocket), so the gate can only move through true lateral member contact, and the tool's own footprint then blocks the doorway it opened, forcing the opposite-direction withdrawal before the passage work can continue.
explanations.decision: Planned checks: official A* positive control solves and replays (39 moves); initial_frozen_walking, freeze_M0, freeze_M1, forbid_mechanism unsolved; prefix_positive/prefix_without for prep->contact, withdraw->goal, postWork->goal; at_most_one_push_then_walk, one_same_direction_translation_process, first_mechanism_then_walking_only_all_histories, walking_to_predocked_use unsolved; blocked_* stance/push restrictions and stage_access_* all passed; 3D playtest: real key events in the official engine reach (3,3,0); observed push states match the verifier's recorded push states at all 10 push steps.
